anchor.semantic_hook: Turning or looking back is made visible by a long forward road passing beneath an eye that faces only toward the route already traveled.
anchor.setting: A long mountain road climbs through a stone arch and continues toward a distant pass, bordered by a low wall and plain milestones without markings. The sole surreal feature is an enormous living eye set into the back of the arch, staring only down the road already traveled.
anchor.absurd_element: an enormous rear-facing eye embedded in the back of a road arch

inserts.action: strides straight toward the distant pass with determined eyes fixed ahead and one palm raised to block the view behind him

variations.scene_adjust: a long stretch of road still winding upward beyond the arch

inserts.action: steps firmly across a row of choice stones on the road, keeps her shoulders and gaze forward, and leaves a discarded key behind her

variations.scene_adjust: a low row of ordinary choice stones across the road and a discarded key

inserts.action: stops mid-step and twists sharply at the waist toward the road behind him, eyes wide and one hand cupped to his ear

variations.scene_adjust: a metal bucket rolling across the road behind the arch

inserts.action: places a cracked compass and a bent key behind the low wall, then turns her chin toward the open pass ahead
stands beside her, points decisively up the forward road, and refuses to turn toward the discarded objects

variations.scene_adjust: a cracked compass and bent key behind the wall, with an open tool case farther up the road

inserts.action: pauses on the steep road with a hiking pack and turns over her shoulder toward the valley, smiling in wonder
stands one pace uphill with a walking pole, turns fully toward the valley, and lifts a hand above his eyes

variations.scene_adjust: hiking packs, walking poles, and a broad valley visible below the wall

inserts.action: walks ahead beneath the arch and begins turning his head back with a curious, hesitant expression
follows several paces behind, waves reassuringly, and carries a bundle of spare hiking poles under one arm

variations.scene_adjust: several spare hiking poles and packs arranged along the following stretch of road

anchor.semantic_hook: Mentioning or touching upon something briefly is made visible by a fingertip that gives one chosen object the lightest possible tap and immediately withdraws.
anchor.setting: A compact discussion room contains a round table, several empty chairs, and a shallow display tray for the subject under discussion. The sole surreal feature is a room-high stone fingertip suspended above the tray, descending for one fleeting tap before springing back upward.
anchor.absurd_element: a room-high stone fingertip that delivers one fleeting tap

inserts.action: stands at the head of the meeting table, gives a miniature unfinished building one quick tap, and immediately reaches toward the next closed folder

variations.scene_adjust: a miniature unfinished building, closed unmarked folders, and a small stack of planning blocks

inserts.action: points sharply at a cracked pipe joint on the tray, raises her other palm in a questioning gesture, and looks frustrated

variations.scene_adjust: a cracked pipe joint, a stopped desk clock without digits, and an untouched place at the table

inserts.action: stands beside an open suitcase, taps a small airplane model with one finger, and gives a tentative sideways glance

variations.scene_adjust: an open suitcase, a small airplane model, a passport-sized blank booklet, and a house key

inserts.action: faces his companion, presses one finger firmly to his closed lips, and slides the party remnants away from the tray
sits across the table with an attentive expression, hands folded, and eyes fixed on the silencing gesture

variations.scene_adjust: a crushed party hat, a snapped ribbon, and an overturned empty glass from the previous weekend

inserts.action: sits in the professor's chair, points briefly between an open laptop and a newly moved exam token on the calendar grid, then withdraws his hand

variations.scene_adjust: an open laptop with a blank screen, an unmarked calendar grid, two plain date tokens, and a stack of closed books

inserts.action: touches a small tangled cord on the tray with one fingertip, keeps the covered box beside it shut, and lowers her eyes anxiously

variations.scene_adjust: a small tangled cord beside a large closed box, with the rest of the tray left empty

anchor.semantic_hook: Leading someone astray is staged literally as a strip of road carrying its traveler away from the proper route and out onto the shoulder.
anchor.setting: A straight driving course crosses a broad training ground, with one paved lane, a gravel shoulder, and an empty observation booth. The sole surreal feature is a long strip of asphalt peeling itself sideways from the lane and curling across the gravel while remaining solid underfoot.
anchor.absurd_element: a solid strip of asphalt peeling sideways off its own road

inserts.action: stands at the split with both hands over her ears, turns away from a speaking horn, and plants one foot firmly on the straight lane

variations.scene_adjust: a plain speaking horn aimed toward the curling asphalt and a straight lane kept clear ahead

inserts.action: kneels far out on the gravel beside a discarded clue object, checks an empty wristwatch, and holds her forehead in weary frustration

variations.scene_adjust: a single glove used as a clue, an empty hourglass, and a long detour across the gravel

inserts.action: sits at the wheel of a small parked car, squints doubtfully at an old dashboard navigator with a blank screen, and brakes at the peeling road

variations.scene_adjust: a small car with an old dashboard navigator showing only an unmarked crooked line

inserts.action: sits bewildered at a classroom desk stranded on the gravel, raises one uncertain hand, and looks between a tangled demonstration model and the straight lane

variations.scene_adjust: rows of empty classroom desks, a tangled demonstration model, and scattered closed notebooks

inserts.action: stands beside a client chair, compares mismatched chart blocks from an open report folder, and urgently points back toward the proper lane

variations.scene_adjust: an open report folder containing only mismatched geometric chart blocks and two empty client chairs

inserts.action: stands apologetically between the straight lane and the gravel, lifts both empty palms, and studies a bent metal hook with a puzzled frown

variations.scene_adjust: a bent metal hook, two differently shaped answer pieces, and a clear path back to the lane

anchor.semantic_hook: Putting something aside or saving it is made visible by moving each chosen object from the central worktable onto a shelf fixed to the side wall.
anchor.setting: A household sorting room contains a broad central worktable, storage drawers, and one deep shelf running along the side wall. The sole surreal feature is the shelf's sideways gravity, which pulls every set-aside object firmly against the vertical wall instead of letting it fall.
anchor.absurd_element: a side shelf whose gravity pulls saved objects onto a vertical wall

inserts.action: counts a small monthly pile of coins, presses it onto the side shelf, and gazes hopefully at a model car on the worktable

variations.scene_adjust: several small coin piles, a plain savings jar, and a model car

inserts.action: moves an afternoon clock onto the side shelf, then leans over an unmarked map with travel tickets and a compass

variations.scene_adjust: a clock face without digits showing afternoon by its hands, an unmarked map, travel tickets without markings, and a compass

inserts.action: places two mismatched puzzle pieces together on the side shelf and turns his full attention to assembling the project model

variations.scene_adjust: two mismatched puzzle pieces and a partly assembled bridge model

inserts.action: carefully presses one slice of cake onto the side shelf, guards it with an outstretched hand, and smiles toward an empty dessert plate

variations.scene_adjust: one slice of cake, an empty dessert plate, and a cake server

inserts.action: pushes his closed work folder onto the side shelf, hoists a moving box, and reaches toward a second box containing a table lamp

variations.scene_adjust: a closed unmarked work folder, moving boxes, a table lamp, and a roll of packing tape

inserts.action: places a reserve pouch of coins on the side shelf beside a first-aid case and checks that both remain secure

variations.scene_adjust: a reserve coin pouch, a first-aid case, a flashlight, and a small fire extinguisher

anchor.semantic_hook: Going to see or check something is made visible by an eye that physically walks from the entrance toward the object needing inspection.
anchor.setting: A long inspection hall contains a central corridor, six open equipment bays, and a waiting bench near the entrance. The sole surreal feature is an enormous glass eyeball on two sturdy walking legs, marching down the corridor toward the active bay.
anchor.absurd_element: an enormous glass eyeball walking down the inspection corridor

inserts.action: hurries into the kitchen bay, crouches beside a rattling saucepan, and reaches cautiously toward its lid

variations.scene_adjust: a kitchen counter, a rattling saucepan, a wooden spoon, and an open cupboard

inserts.action: holds an empty wallet beside the travel bay, recoils from the required heap of coins, and shakes her head
examines a model airplane and the same coin heap, then lowers his shoulders in disappointment

variations.scene_adjust: a model airplane, two suitcases, an empty wallet, and a large ordinary heap of coins

inserts.action: walks quickly to the delivery bay, kneels beside a parcel at the threshold, and raises one hand in a relieved confirmation gesture

variations.scene_adjust: a sealed parcel without markings, a doorstep mat, and an empty delivery trolley

inserts.action: approaches the clinic bay and places the back of her hand gently against her companion's forehead
sits slumped on the waiting bench under a blanket, holds a cup of water, and gives a tired smile

variations.scene_adjust: a folded blanket, a cup of water, a thermometer, and a small medicine case

inserts.action: walks to the planning bay, studies an unmarked weekly grid, and points to the evening space in its fourth column

variations.scene_adjust: an unmarked seven-column calendar grid, a small moon token, and an empty appointment tray

inserts.action: crouches in the plumbing bay, twists a dry tap, peers beneath the basin, and holds a wrench ready

variations.scene_adjust: a sink with a dry tap, exposed pipes, a bucket, and a wrench

anchor.semantic_hook: Saying exactly two brief utterances is made visible as exactly two empty speech bubbles leaving the speaking position.
anchor.setting: A banquet hall contains a low stage, a standing microphone, dining tables, and rows of empty chairs. The sole surreal feature is a pair of room-sized empty speech bubbles hovering above the microphone, with no marks inside them.
anchor.absurd_element: exactly two room-sized empty speech bubbles above the microphone

inserts.action: stands before the dinner table with a grateful smile, raises his glass toward his companion, and holds one open palm near the microphone
sits at the table before the untouched meal, lifts his glass in reply, and listens warmly

variations.scene_adjust: a prepared dinner table, untouched plates, folded napkins, and two raised glasses

inserts.action: stands at the morning meeting table, gestures briefly toward a new project model, and begins sitting down again
sits opposite with hands folded, watches the project model, and gives a concise nod

variations.scene_adjust: a new project model, morning coffee cups, and closed unmarked folders

inserts.action: stands beside a nearly finished birthday cake, politely gestures from his companion toward the microphone, and raises his eyebrows in request
looks from the party table to the stage, touches his chest in mild surprise, and nods agreement

variations.scene_adjust: a birthday cake without markings, opened gifts, plain balloons, and empty dessert plates

inserts.action: stands at the stage steps, points eagerly up toward the microphone, and urges his companion forward with both hands
climbs onto the stage, turns toward the empty guest chairs, and raises one hand to begin speaking

variations.scene_adjust: open stage steps, a standing microphone, and banquet place settings facing the stage

inserts.action: stands frozen at the microphone with wet eyes, presses both hands to his chest, and keeps his mouth closed
waits beside the stage, watches with concern, and offers a steadying hand

variations.scene_adjust: a handkerchief on the podium and two untouched glasses of water

inserts.action: leans urgently toward his departing companion, holds up two fingers, and gestures toward the nearby microphone
pauses beside the exit with his coat over one arm, turns back attentively, and lowers his suitcase

variations.scene_adjust: a coat, a suitcase, and an open exit doorway beside the stage

anchor.semantic_hook: Making applause is staged literally as two hand-shaped molds manufacturing a single solid burst between them.
anchor.setting: A small performance hall contains a low stage, a workbench with two hand-shaped molds, and rows of empty seats. The sole surreal feature is one enormous solid ring formed from captured clapping vibrations, suspended between the molds.
anchor.absurd_element: an enormous solid ring manufactured from captured clapping vibrations

inserts.action: stands beside the workbench, claps broadly toward the evening guest, and beams with welcoming enthusiasm
stands under the suspended ring, places one hand over his heart, and bows toward his host

variations.scene_adjust: an evening coat, a guest chair, and a set table near the stage

inserts.action: stands at the front row after the final curtain, claps continuously, and looks up toward the stage
stands onstage in a theatrical costume, bows deeply, and extends one arm toward the empty place beside him

variations.scene_adjust: a closed stage curtain, a discarded theatrical mask, and several empty actor positions along the stage

inserts.action: stands by the microphone, points proudly toward the successful student, and begins clapping above the workbench
holds a closed unmarked exam folder against his chest, raises a small victory medal, and smiles with exhausted relief

variations.scene_adjust: a stack of closed books, an unmarked exam folder, sharpened pencils, and a small victory medal

inserts.action: gives an exaggerated slow clap with one eyebrow raised and stares at the fresh mess on the floor
crouches guiltily beside another broken drinking glass, holds a dustpan, and avoids her gaze

variations.scene_adjust: a freshly broken drinking glass, an older chipped glass, a dustpan, and a broom

inserts.action: sits at a front classroom desk, claps warmly toward the presenter, and nods with approval
stands beside a finished geometric presentation board, relaxes her shoulders, and smiles gratefully after speaking

variations.scene_adjust: classroom desks, a board containing only geometric shapes, a pointer, and a closed laptop

inserts.action: stands in muddy sports gear beneath the applause ring, accepts the appreciation with a tired bow, and keeps a defeated ball under one arm
stands beside her teammate in matching muddy gear, raises both hands toward the empty seats, and smiles proudly despite the loss

variations.scene_adjust: muddy sports gear, a ball, two water bottles, and a small empty score frame without markings

anchor.semantic_hook: Making oneself known is made visible by operating a device that turns one's own outline into a prominent object for everyone to examine.
anchor.setting: A neighborhood exhibition foyer contains a central pedestal, a mirror, demonstration tables, and several empty viewing benches. The sole surreal feature is a room-high spotlight whose beam casts a solid freestanding human-shaped shadow sculpture onto the pedestal.
anchor.absurd_element: a room-high spotlight that turns a shadow into a solid sculpture

inserts.action: stands before a phone on a tripod, demonstrates a plain product sample with confident gestures, and checks the camera lens

variations.scene_adjust: a phone on a tripod, plain product samples, a small ring lamp, and a parcel without markings

inserts.action: steps out from behind a curtain into the spotlight, relaxes his formerly hunched shoulders, and extends a friendly handshake with a broad smile

variations.scene_adjust: a partly open curtain, an overturned shyly hidden chair, and an open place beside the pedestal

inserts.action: stands at one demonstration table, raises a plain product sample, and waves energetically toward the viewing benches
stands at the second table, aims a megaphone toward a miniature row of townhouses, and gestures toward the new company samples

variations.scene_adjust: a miniature row of townhouses, plain product samples, two megaphones, and unopened parcels without markings

inserts.action: performs at the microphone with a guitar, leans eagerly toward the empty viewing benches, and reaches one hand toward the solid shadow on the pedestal

variations.scene_adjust: a microphone, a guitar, a concert cable, and several empty viewing benches facing the pedestal

inserts.action: turns a large hourglass beside the pedestal, patiently polishes the solid shadow sculpture, and extends an open hand with a trustworthy expression

variations.scene_adjust: a large ordinary hourglass, a polishing cloth, and a handshake space beside the pedestal

inserts.action: stands near a model doorway with an unpacked moving box, offers a tray of pastries, and smiles warmly
approaches from the neighboring doorway, accepts one pastry, and offers a welcoming handshake

variations.scene_adjust: two model doorways, an unpacked moving box, a table lamp, and a tray of pastries

anchor.semantic_hook: An idea crossing the mind is staged literally as a concrete object traveling through a passage shaped around a human mind.
anchor.setting: A quiet thought chamber contains an entry platform, an exit platform, and a narrow track between them. The sole surreal feature is a giant transparent head-shaped tunnel enclosing the track, with ordinary idea objects able to pass directly through its brain chamber.
anchor.absurd_element: a giant transparent head-shaped tunnel for passing ideas

inserts.action: sits calmly beside the tunnel exit, looks away from an office box halted outside the entrance, and keeps his work key securely in hand

variations.scene_adjust: an office storage box, a work key, and a cleared desk object stopped outside the tunnel

inserts.action: holds a phone beside the tunnel, points toward a small helping hand sculpture entering the track, and raises his eyebrows in inquiry

variations.scene_adjust: a phone, two matching family lockets without markings, and a small helping hand sculpture

inserts.action: gently pushes a packed suitcase onto the track through the transparent head and watches it with a thoughtful half-smile

variations.scene_adjust: a packed suitcase, a small airplane model, a passport-sized blank booklet, and a house key

inserts.action: leans tensely over the tunnel, watches a tangled cluster of keys and an empty wallet cross the brain chamber, and bites his knuckle with worry

variations.scene_adjust: a tangled cluster of keys, an empty wallet, and a stopped pocket watch moving along the track

inserts.action: turns away from a wrapped present left outside the tunnel entrance, folds his arms, and walks toward the exit without a grateful gesture

variations.scene_adjust: a wrapped present, an untouched thank-you handshake token, and an empty entrance track

inserts.action: stands ready with a phone in one hand, spots a small alarm bell entering the tunnel, and lifts the phone immediately with urgent focus

variations.scene_adjust: a small alarm bell entering the track, a phone, and an open emergency case

anchor.semantic_hook: Coming to look for someone is made visible by a searching lens that travels the entire approach path toward the person being sought.
anchor.setting: A broad arrivals plaza contains a long approach path, a row of neutral doorways, a parking bay, a waiting bench, and four adjacent platform edges. The sole surreal feature is a giant magnifying lens mounted on walking shoes, striding along the path toward the current search point.
anchor.absurd_element: a giant magnifying lens on walking shoes approaching the search point

inserts.action: walks down the approach path toward her seated companion, gestures gently toward a quiet conversation place, and offers a reassuring smile
waits on the bench with worried shoulders, looks up at her arrival, and opens one hand in readiness to talk

variations.scene_adjust: a quiet bench, two cups, and a small clock without digits set for the following day

inserts.action: knocks firmly at one doorway, holds a silent phone in her other hand, and peers inside with concern
appears inside the doorway in house clothes, notices the missed phone, and raises both palms apologetically

variations.scene_adjust: a home doorway, a silent phone, an untouched doorbell, and house slippers

inserts.action: pulls a small car into the parking bay, leans toward the open passenger door, and waves to his waiting companion
waits near stacked concert equipment, spots the arriving car, and lifts her travel bag with relief

variations.scene_adjust: a small car, stacked concert equipment, a travel bag, and the empty plaza after an event

inserts.action: hurries down the path toward the office doorway, glances at her wristwatch, and raises one hand in an eager greeting
sits at a small office desk, turns from his closed folder toward her, and offers the second coffee cup

variations.scene_adjust: a small office desk, two coffee cups, a wristwatch, and a closed unmarked folder

inserts.action: strides the full length of the approach path toward the home doorway with determined eyes and points to his empty wristwatch
stands at the distant doorway, notices him approaching, and lowers her head with a guilty expression

variations.scene_adjust: a home doorway, an empty appointment chair, an untouched coffee cup, and a wristwatch

inserts.action: stands completely still beside the furthest of four platform edges, grips her suitcase handle, and scans the plaza
approaches along the platform path with searching eyes, notices her at the fourth edge, and raises one arm high

variations.scene_adjust: four adjacent unmarked platform edges, a suitcase, a station clock without digits, and a waiting bench

anchor.semantic_hook: Going away or leaving is made visible by crossing a departure doorway that is itself moving farther from the place being left.
anchor.setting: A spacious departure hall contains a coat stand, a waiting bench, a party table, and a wide opening toward the street. The sole surreal feature is a monumental freestanding doorway on stone feet, slowly walking away from the hall while remaining open.
anchor.absurd_element: a monumental open doorway walking away on stone feet

inserts.action: hurries toward the walking doorway with her coat half on and points anxiously at the gathering rain outside
follows close behind with an umbrella and travel bag, glancing up at the first dark clouds

variations.scene_adjust: an umbrella, two coats, a travel bag, and ordinary rain clouds gathering outside

inserts.action: slips through the doorway at night with his back to the hall, keeps both hands down, and leaves without turning or waving
stands across the hall arranging empty glasses, faces away from his silent departure, and does not notice him

variations.scene_adjust: night beyond the opening, a coat over one arm, and several empty glasses from the evening

inserts.action: steps weakly toward the doorway with one hand on her stomach, a pale face, and her coat held close
remains beside the bench, gestures permission toward the exit, and offers her a bottle of water

variations.scene_adjust: a bottle of water, a folded blanket, a medicine case, and a coat

inserts.action: crosses the doorway with a suitcase and briefcase, looks toward the city street ahead, and leaves his old house key on the bench

variations.scene_adjust: a suitcase, a briefcase, an old house key, and office towers visible beyond the opening

inserts.action: heads toward the doorway in her coat while the newly lit party remains behind her, glancing down at an early clock hand position
stands beside the untouched cake, spreads both hands in astonishment, and points back toward the just-opened party table

variations.scene_adjust: an untouched cake without markings, newly opened refreshments, plain balloons, and a clock face without digits

inserts.action: walks outside beyond the departing doorway with her back to the now-empty hall and carries two folded coats
walks beside her outside with stacked guest cups and a travel bag, already several paces from the hall

variations.scene_adjust: an abandoned party table, empty guest chairs, two folded coats, and used cups being carried away

anchor.semantic_hook: Holding an account of something is staged as physically supporting a counting frame that gathers every factor under consideration.
anchor.setting: A decision chamber contains a planning table, an empty chair, sorting trays, and several ordinary choice objects. The sole surreal feature is a ceiling-high abacus floating at shoulder level, with oversized beads that can cradle the real objects being considered.
anchor.absurd_element: a floating ceiling-high abacus whose beads hold real considerations

inserts.action: braces the giant abacus with both hands, slides several different option objects across its beads, and studies them before touching the decision token

variations.scene_adjust: several option objects including a key, compass, coin pouch, and travel shoe, plus one plain decision token

inserts.action: holds the abacus steady, moves miniature closed shop shutters beside a next-day calendar tile, and raises one cautioning finger

variations.scene_adjust: miniature closed shop shutters, an unmarked calendar grid with its next blank tile raised, and a shopping basket

inserts.action: kneels beside a collapsed project model, notices the nearly empty coin pouch left outside the abacus, and grips her forehead in regret

variations.scene_adjust: a collapsed bridge model, a nearly empty coin pouch outside the abacus, and scattered planning blocks

inserts.action: supports the abacus while placing an umbrella and mountain model together among the beads, then pushes the packed hiking bag away from the departure tray

variations.scene_adjust: a rain-soaked umbrella, a mountain model, a packed hiking bag, and a postponed departure tray

inserts.action: holds the abacus, carefully balances several friends' travel items across different beads, and compares them with three possible route objects

variations.scene_adjust: a hiking boot, camera, snorkel, three route pieces without markings, and a suitcase

inserts.action: steadies the abacus with care, places a folding cane, hearing device, and ramp model among its beads, and checks each one attentively

variations.scene_adjust: a folding cane, hearing device, medicine case, ramp model, and supportive chair
